notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We had a minor hiccup when uploading a new build but everything should be in working order again!

I'm sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused during your gameplay experience and I hope you enjoy your time playing now that everything is fixed!

- Crankage Games

notes.title: Successful Launch Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We just did a VERY minor improvement update that shouldn't have changed much if anything at all, which is a good thing, because it means we've had a GREAT launch with no known issues!

Thank you all VERY much for making this possible and we hope to hear your feedback on the game as soon as you've got a moment to share your thoughts with us!

We always love reading your comments and we hope you're having a fantastic day!

- Crankage Games
